category: premium-account reseller (Indian: INR pricing for Real-Debrid and other hosts)

free_tier.stated: No free tier. Listed as 'Real- Debrid 30 Days Premium Account ... ₹900.00 ... In Stock' on the product page as indexed.
free_tier.notes: The store refused every fetch route tried, so the price is a search-index read and is carried at the reported rung.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable; Real-Debrid's own cap applies

interface_detail: Web store; entitlement or voucher delivered after checkout. Nothing on the page was readable to confirm the delivery mechanism.
tooling: Real-Debrid's own API and clients after activation.
chaining: A third rupee price point for the same European debrid, which matters only for comparison: ₹750 (Debrid-Link), ₹900 (Real-Debrid), ₹500 (AllDebrid).
limits_note: Nothing technical was readable; the page refused every route.
binding_note: No constraint readable at the reseller; Real-Debrid's quotas bind after activation.

identity_cost.detail: Unresolved: the store refused all fetch routes, so no payment-method list was read. An Indian reseller of this shape typically takes card or UPI; that is an expectation, not a finding.

reliability_note: unverified: https://www.hotfilepremiumstore.com/en/real-debrid/112-official-reseller-of-real-debrid-30-days-premium-account.html answered HTTP 404 on 2026-11-03 (a 302 to the same path with SubmitCurrency=1&id_currency=2, then 404, 65053 bytes); routes tried: a rendered page read (404, page text 'The page you are looking for was not found.'), direct probe (404)
confidence_note: Price comes from the search index of the vendor's own product page; A rendered read or a cart test would move this to documented.
